mower_model.title: Mower Model
mower_model.description: The type of mower you are using.

wheel_track.title: Wheel Track
wheel_track.description: Centre-to-centre distance between drive wheels in metres.

wheel_x_offset.title: Wheel X Offset
wheel_x_offset.description: Wheel axle offset from base_link in metres (0 = base_link at wheel axis).

chassis_center_x.title: Chassis Center X
chassis_center_x.description: Distance from base_link (wheel axis) to chassis geometric centre in metres.

caster_radius.title: Caster Radius
caster_radius.description: Front caster wheel radius in metres.

caster_track.title: Caster Track
caster_track.description: Centre-to-centre distance between front casters in metres.

ticks_per_meter.title: Encoder Ticks per Meter
ticks_per_meter.description: Encoder ticks per metre of wheel travel.

tool_width.title: Mowing Tool Width
tool_width.description: Effective cutting width in metres (2 x blade_radius).

wheel_pid_kp.title: Drive PID — Kp
wheel_pid_kp.description: Proportional gain of the firmware per-wheel velocity loop (PWM per m/s). Applied live; higher = stiffer tracking, too high oscillates.

wheel_pid_ki.title: Drive PID — Ki
wheel_pid_ki.description: Integral gain of the firmware per-wheel velocity loop (PWM per m/s·s). Bridges the static-friction deadband; too high overshoots.

wheel_pid_kd.title: Drive PID — Kd
wheel_pid_kd.description: Derivative gain of the firmware per-wheel velocity loop (PWM per m/s²). 0 = disabled (default).

wheel_pid_integral_limit.title: Drive PID — Integral Limit
wheel_pid_integral_limit.description: Anti-windup clamp on the integral term (PWM units, motor max 255).

wheel_pid_pwm_per_mps.title: Drive Feedforward (PWM per m/s)
wheel_pid_pwm_per_mps.description: Open-loop velocity→PWM feedforward scale. Dominant drive term; sets the deadband/idle mapping. Change with care.

sensor_extrinsics.title: Sensor Mounting
sensor_extrinsics.description: Where the sensors sit on the robot (body-frame offsets and rotations). IMU rotation is normally set via the Auto-calibrate button; edit here only for manual overrides.

imu_x.title: IMU Offset X
imu_x.description: Body-frame forward offset of IMU from base_footprint (metres).

imu_y.title: IMU Offset Y
imu_y.description: Body-frame left offset of IMU from base_footprint (metres).

imu_z.title: IMU Offset Z
imu_z.description: Body-frame up offset of IMU from base_footprint (metres).

imu_roll.title: IMU Roll
imu_roll.description: IMU mounting roll (radians). Applied in URDF as rpy; set by /calibration/imu-yaw service.

imu_pitch.title: IMU Pitch
imu_pitch.description: IMU mounting pitch (radians). Applied in URDF as rpy; set by /calibration/imu-yaw service.

imu_yaw.title: IMU Yaw
imu_yaw.description: IMU mounting yaw (radians). Applied in URDF as rpy; set by /calibration/imu-yaw service.

lidar_enabled.title: Enable LiDAR
lidar_enabled.description: Enable LiDAR. Sole source of truth for the ROS2 stack's LiDAR mode (the LIDAR_ENABLED env var is not read). Scan-matching and loop-closure factors in fusion_graph_node are ANDed with it, so they cannot run without a scanner. Default false: this default MUST match robot_config_util.DEFAULT_LIDAR_ENABLED, because the settings backend prunes any value equal to its schema default -- with a default of true, switching LiDAR ON would be pruned away and the toggle would never persist.

lidar_x.title: LiDAR Offset X
lidar_x.description: Body-frame forward offset of LiDAR from base_footprint (metres).

lidar_y.title: LiDAR Offset Y
lidar_y.description: Body-frame left offset of LiDAR from base_footprint (metres).

lidar_z.title: LiDAR Offset Z
lidar_z.description: Body-frame up offset of LiDAR from base_footprint (metres).

lidar_yaw.title: LiDAR Yaw
lidar_yaw.description: LiDAR mounting yaw (radians). Reference robot mounts the LiDAR 180°-rotated.

gps_x.title: GPS Antenna Offset X
gps_x.description: Body-frame forward offset of GPS antenna from base_footprint (metres). Used by fusion_graph_node's GnssLeverArmFactor to subtract the antenna lever-arm from each /gps/fix sample.

gps_y.title: GPS Antenna Offset Y
gps_y.description: Body-frame left offset of GPS antenna from base_footprint (metres).

gps_z.title: GPS Antenna Offset Z
gps_z.description: Body-frame up offset of GPS antenna from base_footprint (metres).

datum_lat.title: Datum Latitude
datum_lat.description: Map origin latitude (WGS84). Set near your docking station.

datum_lon.title: Datum Longitude
datum_lon.description: Map origin longitude (WGS84). Set near your docking station.

datum_alt.title: Datum Altitude
datum_alt.description: Map origin altitude (WGS84 ellipsoidal, metres) — site-specific; no default. Used as the altitude reference when converting GPS fixes to the local map frame.

gnss_receiver_family.title: Receiver Family
gnss_receiver_family.description: Universal GNSS receiver family. Auto is recommended unless you know you need a specific parser.

gnss_receiver_model.title: Receiver Model
gnss_receiver_model.description: Optional Universal GNSS configuration hint passed only to configurator tools when explicitly set. Leave empty for Unknown / Auto.

gnss_serial_device.title: Serial Device
gnss_serial_device.description: Receiver serial device. Prefer /dev/serial/by-id/... for USB receivers.

gnss_serial_baud.title: Serial Baud
gnss_serial_baud.description: Receiver serial baud rate. 921600 is the recommended runtime default.

gnss_profile.title: Receiver Profile
gnss_profile.description: Vendor-neutral Universal GNSS receiver profile id to persist for this robot.

gnss_signal_profile.title: Signal Profile
gnss_signal_profile.description: Vendor-neutral constellation/signal profile used by the future backend translator. Custom is reserved for future profile-file or raw-command workflows.

gnss_profile_rate_hz.title: Position Rate
gnss_profile_rate_hz.description: Requested Universal GNSS receiver update/output rate in Hz.

gnss_config_baud.title: Configured Receiver Baud
gnss_config_baud.description: Persisted target baud for future receiver-side profile application.

gnss_signal_group.title: Raw Signal Group
gnss_signal_group.description: Vendor-specific expert override. Accepts 'master slave', 'master,slave', or 'master/slave' and is normalized on save; advanced Unicore combinations are allowed with warnings instead of a hard allowlist.

gnss_rover_dynamic_mode.title: Rover Dynamic Mode
gnss_rover_dynamic_mode.description: Unicore rover motion model for RTK. Empty = auto (per-model default; UM980 defaults to uav). uav is the kinematic engine (fast fix, holds lock while moving); survey_mow is the near-static survey engine; rover is the generic fallback.

gnss_unicore_pvt_algorithm.title: Unicore PVT Algorithm
gnss_unicore_pvt_algorithm.description: Optional Unicore-specific expert override, for example MULTI.

gnss_unicore_rtk_reliability.title: Unicore RTK Reliability
gnss_unicore_rtk_reliability.description: Optional Unicore-specific expert override for RTK reliability behavior.

gnss_unicore_rtk_timeout_s.title: Unicore RTK Timeout
gnss_unicore_rtk_timeout_s.description: Optional Unicore-specific expert override in seconds.

gnss_unicore_dgps_timeout_s.title: Unicore DGPS Timeout
gnss_unicore_dgps_timeout_s.description: Optional Unicore-specific expert override in seconds.

gps_wait_after_undock_sec.title: GPS Wait After Undock
gps_wait_after_undock_sec.description: Seconds to wait for RTK fix after undocking.

gps_timeout_sec.title: GPS Timeout
gps_timeout_sec.description: Pause mowing if no GPS fix for this many seconds.

ntrip_enabled.title: Enable NTRIP
ntrip_enabled.description: Enable NTRIP RTK corrections for cm-level accuracy.

ntrip_host.title: NTRIP Host
ntrip_host.description: Hostname or IP of your NTRIP caster.

docking_settings.title: Docking
docking_settings.description: Dock position (X, Y, Yaw) is set from the map editor. Other docking parameters can be adjusted here.

dock_approach_distance.title: Dock Approach Distance
dock_approach_distance.description: Staging point distance in front of dock (metres).

dock_approach_overshoot.title: Dock Approach Overshoot
dock_approach_overshoot.description: Forward overshoot (metres) applied to the dock target along its yaw axis. opennav_docking drives toward dock_pose + overshoot * forward and stops at docking_threshold, putting firm contact on the cradle. 0 disables the shift.

dock_max_retries.title: Dock Max Retries
dock_max_retries.description: Maximum docking retry attempts (nav2 docking_server.max_retries). Applied at launch: takes effect after a ROS2 restart.

dock_use_charger_detection.title: Use Charger Detection
dock_use_charger_detection.description: Confirm docking from the charging current (nav2 simple_charging_dock.use_battery_status). Off = the dock is considered reached on pose proximity alone. Applied at launch: takes effect after a ROS2 restart.

dock_charging_threshold.title: Charging Threshold
dock_charging_threshold.description: Battery current (A) at which SimpleChargingDock considers the cradle reached. Higher = more forward press into the contacts before stopping; lower = stops sooner. 0.3 A is a stable seat on the YardForce charger.

mowing_enabled.title: Enable Mowing Motor
mowing_enabled.description: Enable the mowing blade. false = DRY RUN: the robot mows the full path with the blade never spinning (commissioning, coverage tuning). This is a convenience inhibit, NOT a safety cut-out — the STM32 firmware remains the blade safety authority. Read by hardware_bridge_node at startup: takes effect after a ROS2 restart.

transit_speed.title: Transit Speed
transit_speed.description: Robot speed when transiting between zones and to dock (m/s).

path_spacing.title: Path Spacing
path_spacing.description: DEPRECATED / informational only — no ROS2 node reads this. Swath spacing is driven by tool_width (coverage_server.operation_width), so this matches tool_width. A separate value re-opens the swath-gap bug.

headland_width.title: Headland Width
headland_width.description: Width of headland (turning area) in metres.

num_headland_passes.title: Headland Passes
num_headland_passes.description: Number of concentric perimeter rings before the inner field. -1 (or any negative) = none — no perimeter rings. The back-and-forth swaths become the outermost pass, and their centreline lands on exactly the line the outermost ring would have driven (chassis_safety_inset inside the recorded boundary), so sideways they leave the same uncut band as the rings — about 12 cm at the default 0.20 m inset. The swath ENDS, however, reach that same band, roughly 8 cm closer to the boundary than any ring pass gets, and with no mowed apron the row-end U-turns become pivot-through corners instead of smooth arcs. 0 = auto (ceil(headland_width / tool_width)); >0 forces exactly that count.

chassis_safety_inset.title: Chassis Safety Inset
chassis_safety_inset.description: Pre-shrink the operator polygon by this many metres before F2C plans anything. Defaults to chassis_width / 2 so the chassis edge stays inside the polygon under perfect FTC tracking.

min_turning_radius.title: Min Turning Radius
min_turning_radius.description: Minimum turning radius for coverage path (metres). Skid-steer pivots in place; large values force wide F2C U-turns.

mow_angle_deg.title: Mow Angle
mow_angle_deg.description: Swath (mowing line) direction. -1 (or any negative) = auto: the coverage server picks the swath-count-minimising angle. 0..179 forces a fixed swath angle in degrees.

battery_full_voltage.title: Full Voltage
battery_full_voltage.description: Voltage at which battery is considered full. Default 28.0 matches YardForce500 SLA packs on the dock; raise if your pack genuinely reaches a higher resting voltage.

battery_empty_voltage.title: Empty Voltage
battery_empty_voltage.description: Dock if voltage stays below this for 20s.

battery_critical_voltage.title: Critical Voltage
battery_critical_voltage.description: Immediate dock if voltage drops below this.

battery_full_percent.title: Full Percent
battery_full_percent.description: Resume mowing above this battery percentage.

battery_low_percent.title: Low Percent
battery_low_percent.description: Start heading to dock below this battery percentage.

battery_critical_recovery_percent.title: Critical Recovery Percent
battery_critical_recovery_percent.description: Leave the critical-battery state once recharged above this percentage. Hysteresis upper bound, must be greater than Critical Percent.

lift_blade_resume_delay_sec.title: Lift Blade Resume Delay
lift_blade_resume_delay_sec.description: Seconds to keep the blade off after a lift event clears before resuming.

lift_recovery_mode.title: Lift Recovery Mode
lift_recovery_mode.description: Allow autonomous resume after a lift event (default: stay stopped until operator ack).

obstacle_inflation_radius.title: Obstacle Inflation Radius
obstacle_inflation_radius.description: Buffer (m) kept around LiDAR-detected obstacles in the local costmap. Affects TRANSIT path costing only — it does NOT change how closely the robot skirts obstacles while mowing (use Obstacle Clearance Margin for that). Clamped to [0.58, 1.5] at launch. 0.58 (was 1.0): a wider halo smeared side obstacles across a narrow gap's whole front and wedged the robot; kept in sync with the ROS2 template default (mowgli_bringup/config/mowgli_robot.yaml).

obstacle_clearance_margin.title: Obstacle Clearance Margin
obstacle_clearance_margin.description: Sideways room (m) left beyond the chassis when skirting an obstacle while mowing. Raise this if the robot goes around obstacles but shaves past them. Clamped to [0.0, 0.5] at launch.

obstacle_detection_range_m.title: Obstacle Detection Range
obstacle_detection_range_m.description: How far ahead (m) the coverage controller looks for obstacles before starting to skirt. Raise to react earlier and more smoothly. Clamped to [0.2, 5.0] at launch.

obstacle_wait_timeout_s.title: Obstacle Wait Timeout
obstacle_wait_timeout_s.description: How long (s) to wait in place when an obstacle blocks every detour before giving up on the current strip. Lets transient blockages (a person walking past) clear without aborting. Clamped to [0.5, 60.0] at launch.

max_obstacle_avoidance_distance.title: Max Obstacle Detour
max_obstacle_avoidance_distance.description: Maximum lateral detour (m) around obstacles — drives both the coverage controller's skirting and the bypass give-up threshold.

obstacle_margin.title: Drawn Obstacle Margin
obstacle_margin.description: Extra margin (m) around obstacles drawn on the map, applied to both coverage and transit planning. Draw a tree trunk and set this to cover its roots (invisible to the 2D LiDAR).

obstacle_slowdown_ratio.title: Approach Slowdown Ratio
obstacle_slowdown_ratio.description: Speed factor when a scan return enters the chassis+15 cm approach box (LiDAR variant). 0.3 = slow to 30% of commanded speed.

slam_mode.title: SLAM Mode
slam_mode.description: Legacy SLAM toolbox operating mode. Unused — fusion_graph_node (GTSAM iSAM2) is the primary localizer and slam_toolbox is no longer part of the stack. Kept for config backward compatibility.

map_save_on_dock.title: Save Map on Dock
map_save_on_dock.description: Persist map artefacts when the robot returns to the dock.

map_save_path.title: Map Save Path
map_save_path.description: Container path where map artefacts are written.

rain_delay_minutes.title: Rain Delay
rain_delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after rain stops before resuming.

rain_debounce_sec.title: Rain Debounce
rain_debounce_sec.description: Seconds of continuous rain signal before triggering.

led_enabled.title: Enable Status Ring
led_enabled.description: Drive a WS2812 (NeoPixel) status ring from the SBC over SPI MOSI. Read-only display: it never commands the robot and is not part of the blade-safety path (the STM32 keeps its own status LED). Default false MUST stay false and MUST equal the mowgli_bringup template value, because the settings backend prunes any value equal to its schema default -- with a default of true, switching the ring ON would be pruned away and the toggle would never persist (this is exactly the lidar_enabled bug fixed in #508). Requires the SPI4-M0 device-tree overlay plus a reboot before /dev/spidev exists at all; until then the node warns once and stands down.

led_count.title: LED Count
led_count.description: Number of LEDs on the ring. The default of 16 is a placeholder, not a measurement -- set it to what your ring actually has, or the progress arc will be wrong.

led_spi_device.title: SPI Device
led_spi_device.description: spidev character device for the ring's data line (40-pin header pin 19 = GPIO1_C1 = SPI4_MOSI_M0). The spidevB.C numbering is assigned by the kernel, so confirm it with `ls /dev/spidev*` AFTER enabling the rk3588-spi4-m0-cs1-spidev overlay and rebooting -- the default is a best guess. The node warns once and stands down if the device is missing or unreadable.

led_brightness.title: Brightness
led_brightness.description: Linear 0..1 scale applied to every colour channel. Full white on a 16-LED ring at 1.0 draws roughly 1 A; 0.6 keeps it under about 0.6 A and is still readable in daylight.

led_refresh_hz.title: Refresh Rate
led_refresh_hz.description: Render tick in Hz. Frames are only WRITTEN to the ring when they change (plus the keepalive), so a static pattern costs about one write every keepalive interval regardless of this value.

led_keepalive_s.title: Keepalive Interval
led_keepalive_s.description: Re-send an unchanged frame at least this often (seconds), so a ring that lost power mid-run recovers its last state.

led_status_timeout_s.title: Status Timeout
led_status_timeout_s.description: Seconds without a HighLevelStatus before the ring switches to the STALE pattern (amber comet). Also gates the charging fallback read from the hardware bridge's Power message.

led_device_retry_s.title: Device Retry Interval
led_device_retry_s.description: How often (seconds) to silently retry opening a missing or failed /dev/spidev. Only the FIRST failure of an outage is logged, so this never spams.

led_low_battery_percent.title: Low Battery Threshold
led_low_battery_percent.description: Below this battery percentage, and not charging, the whole ring blinks red at 1 Hz. Blinking, where the emergency pattern is SOLID red -- motion is what tells the two apart.

led_charge_full_percent.title: Charge Complete Threshold
led_charge_full_percent.description: At or above this battery percentage a charging ring stops breathing and goes steady full green.

led_idle_scale.title: Idle Brightness
led_idle_scale.description: Brightness of the dim idle ring, relative to the global brightness above.

led_spi_speed_hz.title: SPI Clock
led_spi_speed_hz.description: SPI clock in Hz. The WS2812 symbol table encodes each protocol bit as three SPI bits and is derived from exactly 2.4 MHz (3 bits = 1.25 us). Changing this breaks the bit timing and produces wrong colours; the node warns at startup if it is not 2400000.
